summary_en: Buffalo Inc. initiated a public tender offer for up to 2,999,900 treasury shares at JPY 3,016 per share on November 19, 2026, with total acquisition expenditure of approximately JPY 9.07 billion, representing part of a JPY 14 billion buyback authorization approved in November 2026.
title_en: Notice on Commencement of Public Tender Offer for Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Buffalo Inc. announced the commencement of a public tender offer for treasury stock on November 19, 2026. The company will purchase up to 2,999,900 shares at a price of JPY 3,016 per share, determined as the lower of two calculated prices: (1) JPY 3,021, being 10% below the one-month simple average closing price of JPY 3,357 (October 19 to November 18, 2026), and (2) JPY 3,016, being 5% below the November 18 reference date closing price of JPY 3,175. The tender offer price of JPY 3,016 was selected as it represents the lower of these two amounts.

The total expenditure required for this public tender offer is approximately JPY 9.07 billion, covering the anticipated purchase price for all 2,999,900 shares plus brokerage fees and related costs for public notices, tender offer documentation, and other expenses. This tender offer was authorized as part of a JPY 14 billion treasury stock acquisition framework approved by the board on November 13, 2026, which also includes planned acquisitions through off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3) and market purchases in addition to this public tender offer.
